features.name: Expected result types for ordinary generic member calls
features.scope: Typed locals, property assignments, function returns and generic expected results reach explicit, this-qualified and implicit dispatch-receiver calls through ordinary overload selection and bound checks. Name calls use the existing expected-result selector without forcing unrelated receiver or argument expressions into the result context.
restrictions: Safe-call result inference and implicit extension-receiver member contexts remain bounded.
The pinned compiler accepts incompatible expected Java upper bounds with KT-51221 warnings; intersection/Nothing inference for these cases remains explicitly unsupported.

androidbible.remaining_boundary_at_this_evidence: Java non-null List result loses collection mutability at event.text.add(contentDescription), line266. The unchanged-source receipt is preserved; later flexible-list work is separate.

limitations: Four provider/consumer JVM combinations, a fixed Java caller compiled against official output, generic signatures, runtime null/cast checks, evaluation order, invalid inputs and two unsupported KT-51221 cases are recorded.
The source archive is the exact frozen source for the contextual-member differential. The imported-name follow-up is additionally exercised by the reified-array/Elvis report.
No Android runtime or full-app claim.
